key_insight: SynDebug brings debugging into the fault-tolerant quantum computing stack by adding lightweight assertions directly to encoded programs without increasing logical error rate.
engineering_relevance: This makes practical debugging of large-scale FTQC workflows more feasible for systems engineers working on real error-corrected quantum software.
method: Adds assertion-based debugging primitives inside encoded FTQC execution flows
Works across multiple QEC code families, code distances, and encoded workloads
Targets logic bugs while minimizing added circuit depth and logical overhead
evidence_signal: Across evaluated codes and workloads, SynDebug adds an average 1.8% circuit-depth overhead, is 0% in most cases, and shows no measurable increase in logical error rate.
watch_item: Results appear promising, but integration cost and behavior may vary with specific QEC stacks, code choices, and larger real-world workloads.
paper_title: SynDebug: A Framework to Debug Logic Bugs in Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing Programs
